title: Wuthering Waves Version 3.6 Banner Schedule Confirmed
summary: Kuro's official Version 3.6 update content confirms both banner phases, dates, characters, and weapons.
banner_impact: Version 3.6 Phase 1 runs August 20 to September 10, followed by Phase 2 from September 10 to September 29; the confirmed banner dataset is updated accordingly.
body: Kuro Games published the official Wuthering Waves Version 3.6 update content on August 18, 2026. The notice confirms the version schedule and the featured Convene lineup for both phases.

Phase 1 runs from August 20 at 11:00 through September 10 at 09:59 server time with Qingxiao and Denia, plus Glint of Clouds and Forged Dwarf Star. Phase 2 begins September 10 at 10:00 and runs through September 29 at 11:59 with Jingran, Hiyuki, and Mornye, plus Thousandfold Deliverance, Frostburn, and Starfield Calibrator.
WuWa Banners has updated its confirmed banner history and current schedule from this official notice. Times are shown in server time because the game's Convene schedule uses that clock.

title: Wuthering Waves Official Site Posts New Enemy Information
summary: Kuro published an official enemy-information notice for Wuthering Waves on August 29, 2026.
banner_impact: This notice does not confirm any banner lineup, phase date, featured weapon, or version change, so confirmed banner data remains unchanged.
body: The official Wuthering Waves website published a new enemy-information notice on August 29, 2026. The notice is categorized as game information rather than a banner or version schedule announcement.

For banner tracking, there is no directly verifiable character lineup, weapon lineup, phase timing, or version release information in this notice. WuWa Banners therefore leaves the confirmed banner dataset unchanged.

title: Wuthering Waves Version 3.6 Preview Broadcast Reveals New Update Content
summary: Kuro's Version 3.6 preview broadcast introduced Qingxiao and Jingran, confirmed rerun plans, and detailed the next update's new content.
banner_impact: The broadcast is a real official update and confirms the Version 3.6 banner direction, but this news item does not replace the banner data until the official event calendar provides the exact phase dates and weapon listings in a directly verifiable notice.
body: Kuro Games has completed the Wuthering Waves Version 3.6 Preview Special Broadcast, titled Lamplight in Mirage, Sword's Resolve in Heart. The official update page covers the new story content, Ren Realm areas, Sword Flight, events, and platform optimizations.

For banner tracking, the broadcast introduced the new 5-star Resonators Qingxiao and Jingran and showed the planned rerun direction for Denia, Hiyuki, and Mornye. Their associated signature weapons were also presented during the preview.

WuWa Banners will keep the existing Version 3.5 Phase 2 data live until the official Version 3.6 event calendar confirms exact phase start and end times and the complete weapon lineups in a directly verifiable source.

title: Wuthering Waves Version 3.6 Preview Special Broadcast Set for August 7
summary: Kuro announced that the Wuthering Waves Version 3.6 Preview Special Broadcast will air on August 7, 2026 at 19:00 UTC+8.
banner_impact: This is an official preview broadcast notice, not a confirmed next-banner lineup. The next character and weapon banners remain pending until Kuro publishes the reveal or in-game Convene data.
body: Wuthering Waves has announced the Version 3.6 Preview Special Broadcast for August 7, 2026 at 19:00 UTC+8. The official post points players to the Wuthering Waves YouTube and Twitch livestream channels.

For banner tracking, this is useful because it gives a dated official checkpoint for the next version cycle. It does not yet confirm the next featured characters, weapon banner, phase dates, reruns, or pull advice.
The current confirmed banner data on WuWa Banners remains Version 3.5 Phase 2: Suisui and Aemeath with Firstlight's Herald and Everbright Polestar through August 19, 2026 at 11:59 server time.
